claims.claim: Born 24 June 1992 in Vienna; age 34 on 29 Oct 2026
claims.note: DFB and fussballtransfers both give 24.06.1992; fussballtransfers gives Viena Österreich.

claims.claim: Nationality Austria (not Nigeria)
claims.note: DFB: Nation Österreich. fussballtransfers also lists Nigeria as second nationality; article correctly does not use it.

claims.claim: Signed for Udinese on 24 September 2026
claims.note: Italpress dated 24 Sept 2026; fussballtransfers 'Im Klub seit 24/09/2026'.

claims.claim: Contract runs to 30 June 2027
claims.note: Italpress and SOS Fanta give 30 June 2027. Fanatik only says 'through June 2027'; the article's citation should be italpress-udinese.

claims.claim: Among defenders on Udinese first-team list, number 5
claims.note: Entry '5 David Alaba' under difensori.

claims.claim: Bayern Munich: 431 games in 13 years, ten Bundesliga titles, two Champions Leagues
claims.note: SI: 431 games in 13 years, 10 German titles, Champions League twice. TNT: two CLs and 10 Bundesliga crowns.

claims.claim: Bayern spell ends 30 June 2021 (DFB)
claims.note: Bayern München 01.01.2010 to 30.06.2021.

claims.claim: Joined Bayern in 2008 from Austria Wien reserves
claims.note: Bundesliga.com: played for Austria Wien's reserves before moving to Bayern; DFB shows U17 from 01.07.2008.

claims.claim: DFB Cup debut 10 Feb 2010 v Greuther Fürth, 17 years 232 days, youngest debutant
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: Loan to Hoffenheim second half 2010/11, 17 Bundesliga matches
claims.note: Bundesliga.com and fussballtransfers both give 17.

claims.claim: Van Gaal left-back, Guardiola sometimes centre-back, Flick permanent centre-back; 298 Bundesliga matches
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: Captain for 400th competitive appearance, Dec 2020 v Atlético (CL group)
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: 2012/13 treble: 23 league, 11 CL, 4 DFB Cup; missed 2012 CL final through suspension
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: 2019/20 treble under Flick; 2020/21 tenth title, left pitch 17 min from end v Augsburg
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: Six DFB Cup winners' medals; first from 2010 final, not in matchday squad
claims.note: Source: first of six medals as Bayern won the double; not in matchday squad for 2010 final but got a medal.

claims.claim: Real Madrid confirmed signing on a free transfer on 28 May 2021, aged 28
claims.note: TNT dated 28/05/2021 with free transfer headline; SI: 28-year-old.

claims.claim: Real did not disclose the terms
claims.note: 'Real did not provide details of the contract'.

claims.claim: Alaba announced his departure himself after 2020/21
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: With Real won La Liga and CL in 2022, beating Liverpool in the final
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: Austria debut 14 Oct 2009, 1-3 defeat in Paris v France
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: Youngest player in ÖFB history at 17 years three months
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: ÖFB profile as of 1 June 2016: 45 caps, 11 goals
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: March 2017 Koller named him captain for WC qualifier v Moldova, first start with armband, 55th cap, decision for that match only
claims.note: Article dated 23 March 2017; WM-Qualifikationsspiel; Koller: only for the Moldova game.

claims.claim: Released by Real Madrid at end of 2025-26; left without a club
claims.note: Irish Times: released by Real Madrid at the end of last season.

claims.claim: Mid-September: still seeking a club, no competitive match since early July 2026
claims.note: Report dated 15.09.2026; last competitive match early July (World Cup round of 16 v Spain).

claims.claim: Rangnick left Alaba out of the squad for the upcoming Nations League matches (report of 15 Sept 2026)
claims.note: 'Für die anstehenden Nations-League-Duelle wurde er nicht nominiert.'

claims.claim: Report says the decision came after phone calls and aimed to protect Alaba from physical overload
claims.note: Now attributed to the report, not Rangnick. Report narration confirms both points.

claims.claim: Irish Times: left out because he had no club until signing for Udinese
claims.note: 'signed for Udinese last week, so he was omitted for this window'.

claims.claim: Alaba has not retired from international football; a November absence is realistic
claims.note: Full retirement from ÖFB shirt 'vorerst unbestätigt'; November absence 'ein reales Szenario'.

claims.claim: Central defenders Danso, Affengruber, Bacher; young Querfeld and Ndukwe
claims.note: Exact match (report spells Anel in body, David in FAQ).

claims.claim: Rangnick could review in March 2027 only if Alaba signs soon with a new club and returns error-free
claims.note: 'zeitnahe Unterschrift bei einem neuen Arbeitgeber' and 'fehlerfreie Rückkehr in den Spielbetrieb'.

claims.claim: Collavino: established champion, leader, exemplary professional
claims.note: Exact match.

claims.claim: Alaba: 'I still want to win'
claims.note: Fanatik: 'I still want to win'. Italian: 'Voglio vincere ancora'.

valueNote: Dated timeline of club moves, primary-source checks of birth, contract and caps, and both sides of the Nations League dispute.
summary: Rewording fixes the misattributed quote; all other claims confirmed. Both Nations League sources kept.
